## Spatial predictions of mortality and ATE
```{r}

df_all

# strata 2: treatment arm
```

### Create model predictions per each treatment arm for the two definitions of treatment, `isTreated_child` and `isTreated_alltx`.
```{r}
#--------------------------------------
# get model predictions on a grid
# (see function in washb-geopair-Functions.R)
#--------------------------------------
b_preds_mort_s0       <- get_grid_preds   (input_grid = b_boxgrid,
                                           spamm_model_fit = df_s0)

b_preds_mort_tx0_child <- get_grid_preds_v1(input_grid = b_boxgrid,
                                           spamm_model_fit = df_s0_child,
                                           tx_group="Control")

b_preds_mort_tx1_child <- get_grid_preds_v1(input_grid = b_boxgrid,
                                           spamm_model_fit = df_s0_child,
                                           tx_group="Treatment")

b_preds_mort_tx0_alltx <- get_grid_preds_v2(input_grid = b_boxgrid,
                                           spamm_model_fit = df_s0_alltx,
                                           tx_group="Control")

b_preds_mort_tx1_alltx <- get_grid_preds_v2(input_grid = b_boxgrid,
                                           spamm_model_fit = df_s0_alltx,
                                           tx_group="Treatment")

# b_preds_mort_s1 <- get_grid_preds(input_grid      = b_boxgrid,
#                                   spamm_model_fit = df_s1)
# 
# b_preds_mort_s2 <- get_grid_preds(input_grid      = b_boxgrid,
#                                   spamm_model_fit = df_s2)
# 
# b_preds_mort_s3 <- get_grid_preds(input_grid      = b_boxgrid,
#                                   spamm_model_fit = df_s3)

#--------------------------------------
# convert predicted surface of the mean
# to a raster to make it a regular
# set of tiles (rather than points), 
# then to tibble for ggplot2
# scale prevalence by 100
# to be in units of percent (%)
#--------------------------------------
b_preds_mort_coords_s0        <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_s0)
b_preds_mort_coords_tx0_child <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_tx0_child)
b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_child <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_tx1_child)
b_preds_mort_coords_tx0_alltx <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_tx0_alltx)
b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_alltx <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_tx1_alltx)

# b_preds_mort_coords_s1 <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_s1)
# b_preds_mort_coords_s2 <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_s2)
# b_preds_mort_coords_s3 <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_s3)

b_preds_mort_raster_s0 <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_s0[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_s0[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort_s0$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)

b_preds_mort_raster_tx0_child <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_tx0_child[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_tx0_child[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort_tx0_child$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)

b_preds_mort_raster_tx1_child <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_child[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_child[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort_tx1_child$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)

b_preds_mort_raster_tx0_alltx <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_tx0_alltx[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_tx0_alltx[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort_tx0_alltx$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)

b_preds_mort_raster_tx1_alltx <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_alltx[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_alltx[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort_tx1_alltx$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)
```

### Calculate spatial ATE -- difference between tibbles (merge then mutate a `difference` var)
```{r}

b_preds_mort_raster2_diff_child <- 
  b_preds_mort_raster2_tx0_child %>%
  left_join(b_preds_mort_raster2_tx1_child, by=c("x"="x", "y"="y")) %>%
  rename(mort_tx0 = value.x,
         mort_tx1 = value.y) %>%
  mutate(diff_mort = mort_tx1 - mort_tx0)

#merge quality check
nrow(b_preds_mort_raster2_diff_child) == nrow(b_preds_mort_raster2_tx0_child)
nrow(b_preds_mort_raster2_diff_child) == nrow(b_preds_mort_raster2_tx1_child)
```

### 11/7 Smoothed splines
```{r}

gammort_1to59_child <-  gam(n_deaths_1to59 ~ 
                              isTreated_child + 
                              s(lat,       bs = "cr", by = isTreated_child) +
                              s(lon,       bs = "cr", by = isTreated_child) +
                              # Matern(1|lat + lon) +
                              s(site_code, bs = "re", by = dummy) +
                              offset(log(pt_year_1to59)), # re is on
                            data   = df_all,
                            family = poisson(link = "log"), 
                            method = "REML")
  
  


get_smooths_difference(gammort_1to59_child, 
                       #lat,
                       difference = isTreated_child
                       )
```
